name: Lipid droplet biogenesis and fusion
rationale: All members concern building and organizing lipid droplets (formation, fusion), whereas confusables cover droplet breakdown, lipophagy or triglyceride synthesis.

name: Sweet, bitter, umami and salty taste perception
rationale: Members are taste detection pathways including class C taste GPCRs for sweet/bitter/umami plus salty taste, while confusables add sour taste or olfaction.

core: Restraint of type I interferon and PKR signalling
name: Adenosine-to-inosine RNA editing dampening interferon and PKR signalling
rationale: Members combine ADAR-mediated A-to-I editing with negative regulation of type I IFN and PKR signalling; confusables are TLR7/8/9 or ISG antiviral effector programmes.

core: Viral genome replication and ribonucleoprotein assembly
name: Influenza and RSV genome replication and ribonucleoprotein assembly
rationale: All members cover negative-strand RNA virus (influenza, RSV) RNA synthesis, vRNP assembly and nuclear trafficking, whereas confusables add viral translation, host shutoff or coronavirus replication.

qualifier: ER store release and store-operated entry, non-cardiac
name: ER calcium store release and cytosolic calcium homeostasis
rationale: Members regulate sequestered calcium release, store-operated entry, Na/Ca exchange and cytosolic calcium levels generally, while every confusable adds cardiac-specific contraction and SR pump regulation.

name: Lung alveolar and branched-organ epithelial differentiation
rationale: Members centre on distal lung epithelium (pneumocytes, saccules, secretory cells, bronchial branching) with pancreatic duct and kidney epithelial lineages, unlike confusables focused on mammary/prostate, salivary or nephron development.

name: Mitochondrial genome replication, transcription and translation
rationale: Members span mtDNA replication/repair, mitochondrial transcription, mRNA stability, mitoribosome assembly and translation, while confusables add mitochondrial tRNA processing and RNA import.

name: Purine nucleotide and deoxynucleoside catabolism
rationale: Members degrade AMP/IMP/dGMP and (deoxy)adenosine/inosine via ADA and PNP toward allantoin, whereas confusables cover purine salvage, de novo synthesis or pyrimidine deoxynucleotide catabolism.

name: TGF-beta, BMP and Wnt control of osteoblast progenitors
rationale: Members regulate mesenchymal stem cell and osteoblast proliferation/differentiation through SMAD2/3, BMP and Wnt signalling, while confusables involve mineralization, ossification, trabecular bone or osteoclasts.

name: Nodal and paranodal axon domains in peripheral myelination
rationale: Members cover sodium channel clustering, paranodal junctions, L1/neurofascin/NrCAM-ankyrin interactions and Schwann cell myelination, unlike confusables on CNS myelin, gap junctions or L1 signalling.

name: Th2 differentiation and IL-4/IL-13/IL-33 cytokine signalling
rationale: Members regulate Th2 differentiation and IL-4/5/13 production with IL-4/IL-13 and IL-33 signalling, while confusables emphasize FcεRI mast cell activation, eosinophils or IgE switching.

qualifier: cargo-specific and microautophagy with autophagosome biogenesis control
name: Selective macro- and microautophagy and autophagosome biogenesis regulation
rationale: Members span cargo-selective autophagy (mito-, pexo-, reticulo-, aggre-, xenophagy), CMA, microautophagy and autophagosome assembly/maturation control, unlike confusables on lysosomal fusion, ESCRT or aggresome assembly.

qualifier: bicarbonate, phosphate and sulfate carriers and their disorders
name: Bicarbonate, phosphate and sulfate anion transport and its disorders
rationale: Members are SLC4/SLC26/SLC34/SLC20 anion transport and their inherited defects plus CO2 hydration, while confusables add enamel/tooth mineralization or organelle acidification.

name: ARE-binding protein control of cytoplasmic mRNA decay and stability
rationale: Members cover deadenylation, decapping, 5'-3' decay and AU-rich-element binders (HuR, AUF1, TTP, KSRP, BRF1), unlike confusables on 3'-end processing, miRNA silencing or stress granules.

name: Synaptic vesicle docking, priming and SNARE-mediated fusion
rationale: Members concern vesicle docking, priming, SNARE complex assembly and calcium-dependent fusion, whereas confusables cover transmitter-specific release cycles, short-term plasticity or active zone structure.

name: Ras GTPase regulation by GAPs and oncogenic Ras-MAPK mutants
rationale: Members address Ras activity control by GAPs/NF1 and signalling by RAS, RAS-GAP and MAP2K mutants, while confusables focus on RAF activation, SOS or ERK negative feedback.

name: Neural progenitor maintenance and neuron-versus-glia fate choice
rationale: Members regulate neuroblast/stem cell proliferation and neuronal, astrocyte, oligodendrocyte and Schwann cell differentiation, unlike confusables on midbrain dopaminergic, cerebellar or sympathetic lineages.

name: Glycerophospholipid acyl-chain remodelling and lysophospholipid hydrolysis
rationale: Members remodel acyl chains of PC, PE, PS, PI and PG and hydrolyse LPC/LPE, whereas confusables cover de novo phospholipid or cardiolipin synthesis, endocannabinoids or sphingolipids.

name: Chaperone-mediated folding and aggresome clearance of misfolded proteins
rationale: Members span de novo folding, refolding, unfolding, ER folding and aggresome/aggrephagy, unlike confusables on CCT/TRiC chaperonins, chaperone-mediated autophagy or ubiquitin quality control.

name: Chylomicron and VLDL clearance
rationale: Members concern clearance (and assembly) of chylomicrons and VLDL, whereas confusables cover lipase-driven remodelling or HDL/LDL metabolism.

name: Compartment-specific phosphoinositide and inositol phosphate metabolism
rationale: Members synthesize PIPs at specific membranes and inositol phosphates, with phosphatase regulation, while confusables cover lipid transfer, ER tubular networks or Golgi trafficking.

name: Glucagon-PKA and AMPK regulation of triglyceride metabolism
rationale: Members are PKA, PDE3B and AMPK signalling controlling lipolysis and triglyceride synthesis, unlike confusables on ChREBP glucose sensing, glycogen, gluconeogenesis or LXR.

name: Glycerolipid synthesis and lipid droplet storage dynamics
rationale: Members span PA/DAG/TAG synthesis and lipid droplet formation, fusion, disassembly and lipophagy, while confusables add triglyceride catabolism and PDE3B-driven lipolysis.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I and III plus snRNA
name: RNA polymerase I, III and snRNA gene transcription
rationale: Members cover initiation, elongation and termination by Pol I and Pol III and snRNA transcription, whereas confusables address rRNA processing, snRNP assembly or rDNA chromatin regulation.

qualifier: apical delivery and CFTR in secretory ducts
name: Apical membrane protein trafficking in secretory ductal epithelia
rationale: Members cover apical/basolateral protein delivery, raft localization, CFTR trafficking and ductal anion/water secretion, unlike confusables on tight junctions, bile lipid flippases or phospholipid scrambling.
